high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or fitting area. The individual is wearing a black high-neck top and wide-leg black pants. They have long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders and are barefoot. The person is holding a smartphone with a colorful case, which they are using to take the photo. The setting includes a mirror with a white frame, reflecting the person and part of the room behind them. The background features a dark curtain, likely used for privacy, and a tiled floor.
